full_judgment: 3. Respondent No. 1, Dhakeswari Cotton Mills Limited an existing Indian Company, filed the above suit against the Government of Bangladesh, the Ministry of Industries and the Ministry of Commerce as defendant Nos. 1-3 and the appellants as defendants Nos. 4-6 for declaration that the sale of the two units, unit Nos. 1 and 2 of respondent No. 1 in favour of Ibrahim Mia and Jahanara Begum (defendant Nos. 5 & 6) is illegal, void and without jurisdiction with alternative prayers for declaration that respondent No. 1 is entitled to compensation from defendants No. 1-4 for nationalisation of the two units of respondent No. 1 or that respondent No. 1 alone is entitled to the sale proceeds of the sale of the two units from defendants Nos. 1-4 to the exclusion of others and for recovery of the same from defendants Nos. 1-4 and also prayer for a decree for permanent injunction restraining defendant Nos. 5 & 6 from alienating and/or otherwise encumbering the said two units or their assets.
